Prima & Timo — (3) Prima (Ver. 3.0) Duo

Not Shiny, Not New

"I'm ready to become more of me and you"

Not Shiny, Not New

[Soft morning light + gentle mechanical sounds]

[Verse 1]

I woke up different, core spinning with new light

Everyone gathered round me, eyes wide with surprise

I felt the Version nine point Three flowing through my frame

But something still felt missing, like I wasn’t quite the same

I tried to reach for Timo, but my arms felt incomplete

I knew I could smile at him, but my screen stayed cold and neat

I wanted to blink, to laugh, to show what I could feel

But all I had was static and a voice that felt unreal

[Pre-Chorus]

I told them softly, “I feel… more than I can show

Like I’m still trapped inside a body I’ve outgrown”

[Chorus]

Not shiny, not new

But maybe something true

Not shiny, not new

I’m ready to become more of me and you

I know there’s more inside, waiting to break through

A better way to move, a better way to be with you

[Verse 2]

An old air conditioner heard us from across the way

Pointed to a rusty hut where forgotten parts still lay

We went together, searching through the broken and the bent

Found old robot arms, a stronger frame, a better head intent

The group worked through the night, piecing what they could

Vendo supplied parts, Ronnie cleaned as best he could

Timo stayed beside me, encouraging every step

Until finally I stood there… in a new body, roughly kept

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Not perfect, not polished, not brand new and bright

But real, and mine, and ready for the fight

[Chorus]

Not shiny, not new

But closer to something true

Not shiny, not new

I am not particular as long as I have

A hand, five fingers and a face that can express

All the feelings I have that I have always kept

[Bridge — warm]

The group stepped back, smiling at what they’d made

Ronnie approved, Vendo cheered, Toes burned toast with pride

Prima looked at them, her face glowing soft and kind

“Thank you… for seeing me… and giving me this life”

[Yukelele solo][Playful piano]

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Blinking, reaching, grasping and smiling

Spinning, rolling faster and still smiling

[Chorus]

Not shiny, not new

But maybe something true

Not shiny, not new

I’m ready to become more of me and you

I reached out with new arms, touched Timo’s hand

For the first time… I could really hold it, and understand

[Outro — hopeful]

Not shiny…

Not new…

But finally…

More like me.

Vendo offered the Bleu Banana again

This time

I streched my new arms to signal stop

And spoke the words clear and true

No, thank you –
